summary: Iteration 272 — validated pricing 3-card color styling, subscription cancel flow (backend + Settings UI), and milestone share button (canvas PNG download + toast). All 8 backend tests passed; all frontend flows verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Pricing.jsx: displayPlans hardcodes ['monthly','yearly','full_app_unlock'] — if backend adds a plan_id it won't render. Consider fallback ordering that includes unknown plan ids at the end.
SettingsSubscriptionCard.jsx: uses api.get + api.post but relies on shared api instance passed from parent — verified working. No visible issues.
MilestoneBlessing.jsx: drawBlessingCard runs on every share click (not memoized) — fine since click is rare, but if user rapidly clicks share it rebuilds canvas each time. Debounce not needed.
seed_data_creation: During test: seeded user_subscriptions doc for QA user (plan_id=monthly, status=active, +30d), and 7-day practice_history via seed_seven_day_streak.py. CLEANED UP at end — both collections restored to baseline (0 subs, 0 TEST_STREAK_ entries).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 features from iteration 272 verified: (1) Pricing /pricing renders 3 distinct-colored cards — monthly (cyan border/button), yearly (emerald + 'Save $49 vs monthly' green badge not overlapping title), lifetime full_app_unlock (gold/primary + 'One-time payment' badge). All 3 subscribe buttons keyed correctly. Signin hint shown when logged out. (2) POST /api/payments/subscription/cancel: 404 when no subscription; when active sub seeded, GET subscription-status returns is_subscribed=true/plan=monthly/status=active; cancel returns status=cancelled + expires_at; post-cancel subscription-status still is_subscribed=true, status=cancelled (access retained until expiry). Idempotent second cancel returns cancelled. Yearly + monthly checkout create Stripe checkout_url successfully. (3) Settings /settings: no-sub state shows settings-no-subscription + settings-view-plans-btn. Seeded active sub shows settings-active-subscription with plan 'Monthly Membership', Active badge, 'Active — renews October 7, 2026'. Cancel confirm dialog shows both keep and confirm buttons. Post-cancel: badge='Cancelled', renewal='Cancelled — access until October 7, 2026', cancel button hidden, toast 'Membership cancelled...' shown. (4) Milestone: after seeding 7-day streak and clearing localStorage flag, /dashboard portal shows overlay with both dismiss & share buttons. Share click in headless triggered file download 'soul-temple-7-day-milestone.png' and toast 'Blessing card saved — share it anywhere you like'. Dismiss closes overlay and persists journeyMilestoneCelebrated_7=1. All seeded data cleaned up.
